login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Procedure execution & records
login.devHint: Development sign-in: no password. Never enabled in production.
login.offlineHint: You are offline. Signing in needs a connection; a device that was signed in before opens without one.
login.loadFailed: Could not load users. Check the connection and try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.logoutPending: {n} records have not been uploaded yet. They stay on this device and are uploaded after the next sign-in.
settings.authExpired: Your sign-in has expired. Work continues offline; sign in again to upload.
settings.pinSet: A PIN is set for your account.
settings.pinNotSet: No PIN set. You need a PIN to sign off on a tablet while offline.
settings.storageUnknown: Storage usage not available on this device.
settings.persisted: Storage is protected from automatic clean-up.
settings.notPersisted: The browser may delete offline data when space runs low.
settings.persistDenied: The browser declined. Keep the app installed and sync regularly.

sync.title: Synchronisation
sync.rejectedHint: These records were refused by the server and are not part of the run record. They are kept on this device; report them to a supervisor.
sync.badgeLabel: Sync status: {status}. Tap to sync now.

pin.title: Confirm identity
pin.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {s} s.
pin.noUsers: No user with the required role is available on this device.
pin.invalidFormat: The PIN must be 6 to 12 digits.
pin.saved: PIN saved. It reaches other tablets at their next sync.
pin.onlineOnly: Setting a PIN requires a connection.

checkout.pendingSync: Records of this run are still waiting to be uploaded. The checkout is released automatically after the upload.

editBlocked.offline_not_checked_out: Offline: this run is read-only because it is not checked out to this tablet.
editBlocked.locked_by_other: Another device is working on this step.
editBlocked.not_locked: Take this step to start working on it.
editBlocked.checked_out_by_other: This run is checked out to another device.

validation.runClosed: The run is closed; nothing more can be recorded.
validation.roleSupervisor: Only a supervisor may do this.
validation.roleCompleteRun: Only an inspector or supervisor may complete the run.
validation.roleOperator: You need the operator role to record this.
validation.unknownStep: This step does not exist in the run's procedure revision.
validation.unknownInput: This input does not exist in the step.
validation.unknownSupersedes: The corrected record was not found in this run.
validation.supersedesDead: That record has already been corrected or rejected.
validation.supersedesMismatch: A correction must refer to a value of the same input.
validation.invalidValue: The value is not valid for this input.
validation.invalidNumber: Enter a number with the required number of decimals.
validation.tooManyDecimals: Too many decimal places. Values are never rounded; enter the value with the required precision.
validation.invalidPhotos: The photos could not be recorded.
validation.tooManyPhotos: Too many photos for this input.
validation.scanMismatch: The scanned code does not match what this step expects.
validation.toolExpired: This tool's calibration has expired. Use a calibrated tool.
validation.toolUnknown: This tool is not in the tool register.
validation.toolInactive: This tool is withdrawn from use.
validation.signoffRole: You do not hold the role required for this sign-off.
validation.stepAlreadyCompleted: The step is already completed. A supervisor must reopen it before values change.
validation.stepInConflict: Conflicting records exist for this step. A supervisor must resolve them first.
validation.missingRequired: Fill in all required inputs first.
validation.missingPhotos: Take the required number of photos first.
validation.outOfToleranceNeedsNcr: A value is out of tolerance. Raise an NCR before completing the step.
validation.toolNeedsNcr: A tool used here is expired or unknown. Raise an NCR before completing the step.
validation.verifierRole: You do not hold the role required to verify this step.
validation.verifierIsCompleter: The person who completed the step cannot verify it.
validation.unknownNcr: NCR not found in this run.
validation.ncrNotDispositioned: The NCR must be dispositioned before it can be closed.
validation.unknownEvent: A referenced record does not belong to this step.
validation.runCannotComplete: The run cannot be completed yet: every step must be done (and verified where required) with no open NCR or conflict.
validation.unknownRevision: The procedure revision is not available on this device.
validation.revisionNotReleased: Only released revisions can be executed.
validation.unknownRun: The run is not available on this device.
